items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Ceriuti's was a place on Madison Avenue that hired colored entertainers.

ctx.x: Yeah. May Bonds(?)... One time, when Dave Tough came from Paris and worked Ceriuti's, he said, "Come on, I want you to meet this girl." And this is back in 1930...

Ceriuti's was a place on Madison Avenue that hired colored entertainers. A beautiful place. Good artists worked there. So he said, "I want you to see this girl. She's something." So he took me to a place named
